window_class.label: Window class
window_class.description: Extended regular expression (case-insensitive) matched against the Hyprland window class of RuneLite client windows.

exclude_title.label: Excluded window titles
exclude_title.description: Extended regular expression (case-insensitive). Windows whose title matches are ignored, such as the RuneLite splash screen and Java popup windows.

directory.label: Output Directory
directory.description: Where recordings and replays are saved. Defaults to ~/Videos/RuneLite when empty.

filename_pattern.label: Recording Filename Pattern
filename_pattern.description: strftime pattern without extension. {character} is replaced with the character name, or "unknown" when not logged in.

video_encoder.label: Video Encoder
video_encoder.description: CPU encoding only supports H.264, GPU is hardware-accelerated

video_qp.label: Video Quality (QP)
video_qp.description: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files

video_bitrate.label: Video Bitrate (kbps)
video_bitrate.description: Positive integer bitrate in kbps used for CBR mode

custom_audio_sources.label: Custom Audio Sources
custom_audio_sources.description: Comma-separated gpu-screen-recorder audio sources, e.g. app:java or default_output.

on_resize.label: When the Window Is Resized
on_resize.description: gpu-screen-recorder freezes when the captured window changes size. Restart the capture, or stop it and notify.

resize_settle.label: Resize Settle Time (s)
resize_settle.description: Restart only after the window size has stayed the same for this many seconds.

start_mode.label: Start Mode
start_mode.description: Automatic starts the replay buffer when a RuneLite session appears. Manual waits for you to start it.

auto_session.label: Session to Record
auto_session.description: Which session is picked when none is chosen explicitly.

follow_next_session.label: Follow Next Session
follow_next_session.description: When the recorded client closes while others run, move the replay buffer to the next one.

stop_grace.label: Stop Delay (s)
stop_grace.description: After the last client closes, wait this long before stopping, in case the client restarts.

replay_filename_pattern.label: Replay Filename Pattern
replay_filename_pattern.description: strftime pattern without extension, applied when the replay is saved. {character} is the character at that moment, or "unknown".

post_save_script.label: Post-save Script
post_save_script.description: Executable run after a clip is saved and renamed, with the final path and the type (replay or regular) as arguments.

notify.picker-missing: RuneLite Recorder: portal picker not set up
notify.picker-missing-body: The window will be chosen in the portal dialog. Run: noctalia msg plugin fredrikj/runelite-recorder:service all setup-picker
notify.picker-setup-failed: Could not configure the portal picker
notify.stopped-early: gpu-screen-recorder exited unexpectedly. Check the Noctalia log for details.
notify.unavailable: gpu-screen-recorder or Hyprland is not available
notify.stopped-after-resize: Recording stopped: RuneLite window was resized

panel.title: RuneLite Sessions
panel.unavailable: gpu-screen-recorder or Hyprland is not available
panel.select-hint: Click a session to record it
